home.intro: On the Dorpsplein in Zandvoort, two minutes from the beach. Open every day from {open} to {close}.
home.about.title: The club on the square
home.about.text: Yanks has been on the village square for decades. Besides the coffeeshop there is a bar, pool tables, game tables and big screens, all in a Native American interior. You order at your table with a QR code, and the prices are on one big board.
home.terrace.title: The terrace
home.terrace.text: A big terrace with wooden tables and benches, a roof that opens when the weather is good and heaters for the evening.
home.terrace.alt: The Yanks terrace: carved wooden benches and tables under a retractable roof.
home.late.title: Open late
home.late.text: Every day until {close}. From {dineInUntil} it is takeaway only.
home.beach.title: Two minutes from the beach
home.beach.text: The North Sea beach is a two-minute walk from the Dorpsplein. From Amsterdam Centraal the train takes about half an hour.
home.menu.text: Coffee, tea, soft drinks and something to eat, from breakfast to the last hour.
home.shop.text: Souvenirs from a real place on the square. Two of them are numbered.

kb.description: Twelve things to know about using cannabis responsibly, from Yanks Indian Club in Zandvoort.
kb.intro: Twelve short points on using cannabis responsibly. Questions? Ask the staff.
kb.1.title: Buy in a coffeeshop, not on the street
kb.1.text: On the street you don't know what you get. In a coffeeshop the staff can tell you.
kb.2.title: Your choice, your responsibility
kb.2.text: You decide whether and how you use. Now and then is one thing; every day to be away from the world is another.
kb.3.title: Don't take it abroad
kb.3.text: Don't take cannabis with you when you travel to another country.
kb.4.title: Not in traffic, at school or at work
kb.4.text: Cannabis affects your concentration. Don't use it when you drive, study or work.
kb.5.title: How long it lasts
kb.5.text: Cannabis has been known in many cultures for centuries. The effect usually lasts two to four hours.
kb.6.title: If it goes wrong
kb.6.text: You may feel sick or anxious. Stay calm, find a quiet place and eat or drink something sweet. The worst is over within an hour.
kb.7.title: Medication and pregnancy
kb.7.text: Taking medication? Ask your doctor first. Pregnant? Don't use.
kb.8.title: Smoke is harmful
kb.8.text: Smoking releases tar and carbon monoxide. With tobacco you also take on the risks of smoking tobacco.
kb.9.title: Not with alcohol
kb.9.text: Alcohol and cannabis don't go well together, especially if you have little experience.
kb.10.title: It doesn't solve problems
kb.10.text: Don't use cannabis to avoid problems. If you use every day, stop for a few days each week.
kb.11.title: Ask the staff
kb.11.text: Strengths differ a lot. The first time you don't know how much you can take: ask for information first.
kb.12.title: Space cake takes time
kb.12.text: It takes 45 to 90 minutes to work. Be patient and don't take another piece.
